summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with SHACLPathError and parse_shacl_path, and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with one parametrized test. The new tests and the existing test/test_path.py pass (40 passed) using the generator venv. Nothing was committed, and no existing file was changed. Not verified: ruff, black, and mypy are not installed in the generator venv, so lint and type checks were not run. Line lengths were checked with awk, and type-ignore placement was checked by reading the code only.
